name: frontend-design
description: Design and implement visually strong web interfaces and decision-complete design strategies. Use for landing pages, product UI, dashboards, prototypes, redesigns, or translating accepted design into code. Preserve authoritative behavior and existing systems, then verify rendered results.

interface.short_description: Design strong UI from strategy to browser evidence
interface.default_prompt: Use $frontend-design to ground a design strategy in authoritative sources, reuse the existing UI system, produce the requested deliverable, and report only the completion status supported by matching evidence.

name: web-ui-reviewer
description: Review web UI code and rendered states against project requirements and Web Interface Guidelines. Use for UI/UX, accessibility, design, content, form, or frontend-performance audits that need scoped findings and evidence limits; not implementation or conformance certification.

interface.short_description: Review web UI with scoped evidence
interface.default_prompt: Use $web-ui-reviewer to audit this web interface and report scoped, actionable findings with evidence limits.

name: react-spa-engineer
description: Design, implement, review, and diagnose React SPAs using TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form with Zod, React Router, and Dexie. Use for routing, server/runtime state, forms, browser storage, performance, testing, or accessibility; exclude SSR, RSC, and Next.js architecture.

interface.short_description: Build and verify integrated React SPA flows
